nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) holding every account's token balance; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) holding spend approvals; written by _approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private uint256 total token supply; increased by _mint (SafeMath.add) and decreased by _burn.
Public constant 8888888888 * 10**18, the invariant the SkyX constructor validates against totalSupply().
Private address declared in ERC20 but never assigned or used; dead ownership slot.
ERC20 base constructor; stores name, symbol and default decimals(18).
SkyX constructor: validates holders.length == balances.length, loops _mint over caller-supplied arrays, then requires totalSupply() == TOTAL_SUPPLY.
Internal mint: bumps _totalSupply and _balances[account] with SafeMath.add and emits Transfer.
Internal transfer: subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance via SafeMath.
Internal approval: writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Public transfer wrapper using _msgSender() as the source of funds.
Public transferFrom: moves tokens then reduces the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Public approve wrapper setting allowance from _msgSender().
Public view returning _balances[account].
Adds addedValue to the caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
Subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Checked addition helper reverting on overflow.
Checked subtraction helper reverting when the result would be negative.
Library helper performing an unguarded low-level call.value transfer to an arbitrary payable recipient.
Context helper that returns msg.sender as the effective caller.
_totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint; supply invariant depends on SafeMath.add and on who may trigger minting.
_balances[sender].sub(amount) in _transfer; reverts on underflow through SafeMath.sub.
_balances[recipient].add(amount) in _transfer; overflow-guarded only by SafeMath.add.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount) in transferFrom; spends the caller-controlled allowance.
(bool success,) = recipient.call.value(amount)("") in Address.sendValue; forwards all gas to an untrusted address.
for (i = 0; i < holders.length; i++) _mint(holders[i], balances[i]); unbounded loop over caller-supplied arrays, only length equality is validated.
msg.sender, reached through Context._msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller identity.
address[] parameter of the SkyX constructor listing the initial recipients.
uint256[] parameter of the SkyX constructor listing the initial mint amounts.
string parameter of the ERC20 constructor assigned to _name.
string parameter of the ERC20 constructor assigned to _symbol.
address parameter of _transfer/transferFrom identifying the debited account.
address parameter of _transfer identifying the credited account.
uint256 parameter carrying the token value in transfer/_transfer/_mint/_approve and the ETH value in sendValue.
address parameter of _approve/approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance receiving the allowance.
address parameter of _mint and balanceOf identifying the credited/queried account.
uint256 loop index used in the SkyX constructor mint loop.

edges.reason: ERC20 constructor name parameter is written into _name.
ERC20 constructor symbol parameter is written into _symbol.
holders array flows into the SkyX constructor and drives the whole mint loop.
balances array flows into the SkyX constructor and supplies the minted amounts.
SkyX constructor executes the mint loop over the supplied arrays.
holders.length is the loop bound; a huge array makes gas usage attacker-controlled.
balances[i] is the amount minted each iteration.
loop counter i indexes both arrays in the unchecked loop.
Each loop iteration calls _mint(holders[i], balances[i]) with unvalidated entries.
TOTAL_SUPPLY constant is compared against totalSupply() in the constructor require.
_mint credits amount to the account parameter.
_mint performs the supply arithmetic _totalSupply.add(amount).
Mint arithmetic writes the new value into _totalSupply.
Supply increase is delegated to SafeMath.add for overflow protection.
_mint increases the recipient balance inside _balances.
_transfer debits the sender parameter.
_transfer credits the recipient parameter.
_transfer moves the amount parameter between balances.
_transfer executes _balances[sender].sub(amount).
Subtraction result is written back into _balances[sender].
Subtraction relies on SafeMath.sub to revert on underflow.
_transfer executes _balances[recipient].add(amount).
Addition result is written back into _balances[recipient].
Addition relies on SafeMath.add for overflow protection.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transfer derives its source account from _msgSender().
transferFrom first performs the token movement via _transfer.
transferFrom then updates the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom deducts the spent amount from the allowance with SafeMath.sub.
Reduced allowance value is stored back into _allowances.
Allowance lookup is keyed on msg.sender, so the caller controls how much allowance is consumed.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() both as spender and allowance key.
Context._msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
approve sets the owner of the allowance to _msgSender().
increaseAllowance rewrites the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance rewrites the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of _msgSender().
_approve stores the granted amount into _allowances[owner][spender].
_approve uses the spender parameter as the allowance key.
Address.sendValue reaches the unguarded low-level value call.
recipient.call.value(amount)("") transfers control to an attacker-controlled address that can re-enter the caller.
The amount parameter is forwarded as ETH value in the external call.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
balanceOf indexes _balances with the account parameter.
Each holders[i] entry is passed as the credited account of _mint.
Each balances[i] entry is passed as the minted amount of _mint.

normalization_plan.reason: holders only carries the initial recipient list into the SkyX constructor loop, so it can be folded into that function node.
balances only carries the initial mint amounts into the SkyX constructor loop and has no independent effect.
name is a one-shot constructor argument written straight into _name.
symbol is a one-shot constructor argument written straight into _symbol.
sender is only used as the debited account inside the internal transfer routine.
recipient is only used as the credited account inside the internal transfer routine.
amount is the moved value consumed by the balance arithmetic of _transfer and by the value call.
spender is only used as the allowance key inside the internal approve routine.
account is the credited address consumed by _mint and read by balanceOf.
i exists solely as the index of the constructor mint loop and has no meaning outside it.
